verdict.rationale: Qodo's code-governance docs, aimed at engineering leaders, promise a 'complete history of findings, decisions, and codebase health' and 'insight into how code r[eviews]…' across repositories. That implies org-level visibility into findings and accept/dismiss decisions, but no dashboard is actually documented. Missing for 10: explicit acceptance-rate metrics, review-coverage reporting, documented dashboard/analytics UI details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
